text_en: “Do not human beings have a hard service on earth, and are not their days like the days of a laborer?
text_cn: 人生在世，岂不像服兵役？人的岁月，岂不像佣工的时日？

text_en: Like a slave who longs for the shadow, and like laborers who look for their wages,
text_cn: 有如奴工切望阴凉，佣工期待工资：

text_en: so I am allotted months of emptiness, and nights of misery are apportioned to me.
text_cn: 这样，我也只有承受失意的岁月，为我注定的苦痛长夜。

text_en: When I lie down I say, ‘When shall I rise? ’ But the night is long, and I am full of tossing until dawn.
text_cn: 我卧下时说：“几时天亮？”我起来时又说：“黑夜何时到？”我整夜辗转反侧，直到天亮。

text_en: My flesh is clothed with worms and dirt; my skin hardens, then breaks out again.
text_cn: 我的肉身以蛆虫与泥皮为衣，我的皮肤破裂流脓。

text_en: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and come to their end without hope.
text_cn: 我的日月速于织梭，也因无希望而中断。

text_en: “Remember that my life is a breath; my eye will never again see good.
text_cn: 请你记住：我的生命无非像一口气，我的眼再也见不到幸福。

text_en: The eye that beholds me will see me no more; while your eyes are upon me, I shall be gone.
text_cn: 注目于我的，再也见不到我；你的眼看我时、我已不在了。

text_en: As the cloud fades and vanishes, so those who go down to Sheol do not come up;
text_cn: 他去了，好像云消雾散；下到阴府的，再也不得上来。

text_en: they return no more to their houses, nor do their places know them any more.
text_cn: 不再回家，本乡也不认识他。

text_en: “Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
text_cn: 为此，我不能再闭口不言，我要吐露我心灵的忧愁，陈述我灵魂的苦楚。

text_en: Am I the Sea, or the Dragon, that you set a guard over me?
text_cn: 我岂是海洋或海怪？你竟派警卫把守我。

text_en: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me, my couch will ease my complaint, ’
text_cn: 我若想：“我的床榻会宽慰我，我的卧铺会减轻我的痛苦。”

text_en: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me with visions,
text_cn: 你就以噩梦扰乱我，以异像惊吓我。

text_en: so that I would choose strangling and death rather than this body.
text_cn: 我的心灵宁愿窒息，宁死不愿受此苦痛。

text_en: I loathe my life; I would not live forever. Let me alone, for my days are a breath.
text_cn: 我已筋疲力尽，活不下去。任凭我去罢！因为我的日月仅是一口气。

text_en: What are human beings, that you make so much of them, that you set your mind on them,
text_cn: 人算什么，你竟如此显扬他，将他置诸心头，

text_en: visit them every morning, test them every moment?
text_cn: 天天早晨看护他，时刻不断考察他？

text_en: Will you not look away from me for a while, let me alone until I swallow my spittle?
text_cn: 你到何时才不注视我，而让我轻松咽一下唾沫？

text_en: If I sin, what do I do to you, you watcher of humanity? Why have you made me your target? Why have I become a burden to you?
text_cn: 监察人者啊！我犯罪与你何干？为何叫我当你的箭靶，使我成为你的重担？

text_en: Why do you not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity? For now I shall lie in the earth; you will seek me, but I shall not be. ”
text_cn: 为何你不肯容忍我的过错，宽赦我的罪恶？不久我将卧在尘土中，任你寻找我，我已不在了。
